semantic_cases.name: effective_grants_isolated_by_exact_authority_pair
semantic_cases.given: one principal DID has different active grants at two Principal Servers
semantic_cases.action: query each exact subject authority pair
invariants: each query returns only grants whose subject and subject_principal_server_id both match
the server does not infer a Principal Server from the bearer, local service, DID document or member delivery binding

semantic_cases.name: missing_or_wrong_principal_server_selector_fails_closed
semantic_cases.given: subject is valid but subject_principal_server_id is absent, malformed or selects another account authority
invariants: no grant from another authority pair is returned

semantic_cases.name: review_receipt_closes_grant_receipt_and_signer_pair
semantic_cases.given: grant subject pair, receipt reviewer pair and verification-method controller projection are identical
semantic_cases.action: verify review receipt digest and proof transcript
invariants: principal_server_id is present in the proof transcript
bearer session authority alone is never sufficient

semantic_cases.name: cross_pair_replay_and_signer_substitution_fail_closed
semantic_cases.given: the same reviewer DID replays a receipt at another Principal Server or substitutes a grant or signer from another pair

semantic_cases.name: quorum_deduplicates_same_actor_across_principal_servers
semantic_cases.given: one reviewer DID has multiple individually valid receipts from different Principal Servers
semantic_cases.action: evaluate quorum over every input permutation
invariants: eligibility and signature validation remain exact-pair checks
the canonical tie-break compares decoded review_receipt_digest octets bytewise greatest and is invariant under arrival order
multiple Principal Server accounts cannot satisfy quorum alone
